title: The Docker engine API is reachable
summary: The Docker remote API answers unauthenticated, which is control of the host: an attacker can start a container that mounts the disk.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("ApiVersion") and body_contains("GoVersion") and body_contains("Os") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Never expose the Docker API; bind it to a local socket with TLS and auth.
